saw_lines: Parents buy kids’ clothes in sizes that expire, so they shop by stage and reorder each season, not by brand.
So the sale is won in line one, where a parent sees their child’s stage named and acts now.
Your 8 of 23 copy ads repeat one identical text, so swap the opening line and creative in each of those 8 and keep the body copy.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 12 Oct 2026
points: 8 of your 23 copy ads run one identical text, so a parent who sees it twice gets no new reason to buy. Swap the opening line and creative in each of those 8 ads, and keep the body copy.

None of your 30 ads carries a proof number, so a parent has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, like a review count or orders shipped, and print it on the creative of each new ad.

8 of your 23 copy ads open on the same line, “Nunca es demasiado pronto ni demasiado tarde”, so the account tells one story over and over. Test two new angles, like the outgrown size and a parent’s routine, against it.

4 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not to the product they show, so the click loses the item the parent just saw. Point each of those ads to the product in its creative before the next batch runs.
